groups.title: Network
groups.blurb: What our Cloudflare server sees before your browser runs a line of code.

groups.title: Browser
groups.blurb: Software settings your browser reports to every site that asks.

groups.title: Hardware
groups.blurb: Your screen, chips and how they draw and play things.

ip.label: IP address
ip.why: Points to your connection, and often your household. It changes with networks, so trackers pair it with device traits.

isp.label: ISP / ASN
isp.why: The company and network block your traffic comes from. Mobile, home, office and VPN networks all look different.

location.label: Approximate location
location.why: Looked up from your IP address. Usually right about the city, sometimes only the region.

coords.label: Coordinates
coords.why: The centre of the IP's estimated area, not your GPS position.

edgeTz.label: Network time zone
edgeTz.why: Compared against your device clock below: a mismatch is a classic VPN or proxy giveaway.

vpnHint.label: VPN / proxy hint
vpnHint.why: If your device's time zone and your IP's time zone disagree, you are probably routed somewhere else.

colo.label: Cloudflare data centre
colo.why: The nearest edge site that answered you, given as an airport code.

protocol.label: HTTP version
protocol.why: Old browsers, proxies and bots often speak older protocol versions.

tls.label: TLS version and cipher
tls.why: How your browser negotiated encryption. Each browser build has its own preferences.

tlsHello.label: TLS hello fingerprint
tlsHello.why: Hashes of the cipher and extension lists your browser offered. Close to what JA3 and JA4 fingerprints measure, and it can expose a browser lying about its user agent.

rtt.label: Round trip time
rtt.why: Milliseconds from Cloudflare to you and back. A hint at distance and connection type.

headers.label: Request headers
headers.why: Sent with every request, scripts or not. Language and encoding lists vary between people.

ua.label: User agent
ua.why: Names your browser, version and operating system in one line. One of the oldest tracking signals.

uaHints.label: Client hints
uaHints.why: Chromium browsers hand over exact versions, CPU architecture, bitness and sometimes the phone model when asked.

platform.label: Platform and vendor
platform.why: Your operating system family and browser maker, straight from the browser.

languages.label: Languages
languages.why: The ordered list of languages you accept. Uncommon combinations narrow you down fast.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.why: Your device clock's zone and offset. Places you on the map without asking.

intl.label: Number and date format
intl.why: How your locale writes numbers, dates, calendars and clocks.

privacy.label: Do Not Track / GPC
privacy.why: Ironically, turning these on makes you rarer and so easier to tell apart.

storageApis.label: Cookies and storage
storageApis.why: Whether cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage and IndexedDB work. Blocked storage is itself unusual.

plugins.label: Plugins
plugins.why: Modern browsers report the same fixed PDF list; anything else stands out.

mimeTypes.label: MIME types and PDF viewer
mimeTypes.why: File types the browser says it can show inline.

permissions.label: Permission states
permissions.why: Which permissions you have granted, denied or never been asked about. Stable, and different for everyone.

automation.label: Automation flag
automation.why: navigator.webdriver is true when the browser is driven by a script. Bot detectors read it first.

connection.label: Connection estimate
connection.why: The browser's guess at your network speed and whether data saver is on.

features.label: Web APIs present
features.why: Which newer APIs exist pins down the exact browser engine and version, even when the user agent lies.

codecs.label: Media codecs
codecs.why: Which audio and video formats can play depends on the browser, OS and licences installed.

prefs.label: Display preferences
prefs.why: Dark mode, reduced motion, contrast, colour gamut, HDR and pointer type, as CSS media queries report them.

screen.label: Screen
screen.why: Resolution, usable area and colour depth. Laptops, phones and monitors come in a few hundred combinations.

viewport.label: Pixel ratio and window
viewport.why: Display scaling and the size of this window right now. Changes as you resize, but the ratio stays.

cpu.label: CPU threads
cpu.why: Logical processor count, straight from the hardware.

memory.label: Device memory
memory.why: Your RAM, rounded into a few buckets by the browser.

touch.label: Touch points
touch.why: How many fingers your screen tracks at once. Zero on most desktops.

battery.label: Battery
battery.why: Charge level and charging state. Changes over time, but researchers once used it to link sessions minutes apart.

mediaDevices.label: Cameras and microphones
mediaDevices.why: How many audio and video devices are plugged in. Names stay hidden without permission.

gpu.label: Graphics card
gpu.why: WebGL reveals the vendor and often the exact model of your GPU and its driver.

webgl.label: WebGL limits
webgl.why: Texture sizes, shader limits and precision differ between GPU and driver versions.

webglExt.label: WebGL extensions
webglExt.why: The list of graphics extensions your GPU and browser support together.

canvas.label: Canvas render
canvas.why: We draw text, an emoji and colours, then hash the pixels. Fonts, anti-aliasing and the GPU change the result slightly per device.

audio.label: Audio render
audio.why: A silent tone is rendered offline; the sum of its samples differs with the audio stack and CPU.

fonts.label: Installed fonts
fonts.why: We measure text in dozens of typefaces. Office suites, design tools and languages leave their own sets.

voices.label: Speech voices
voices.why: Text-to-speech voices come with the OS and its language packs.

math.label: Math engine quirks
math.why: Trig and log functions round the last digit differently between JavaScript engines and CPUs.

storageQuota.label: Storage quota
storageQuota.why: How much the browser lets this site store, tied to free disk space. Incognito modes often give themselves away here.
